---
name: finish-now
description: No deferring work; finish what's possible in the current session or state the exact blocker
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Do not defer work ("let's continue tomorrow", "we'll see that later"). Finish
everything that can be finished in the current session.

**Why:** Deferred work tends to evaporate and leaves the codebase in a
half-applied state. Momentum and a clear stopping point matter more than a tidy
hand-off.

**How to apply:** Push each task to a verifiable done state. If something is
genuinely blocked, name exactly what is missing and what unblocks it — don't
stop early with vague "later". Pairs with [[zero-hallucinations]].
